presets.label: US tariff on Canadian oats & wheat
presets.headline: HYPOTHETICAL: United States imposes a new tariff on imports of Canadian oats and wheat starting this spring.

affected.reasoning: The US is a key destination for Canadian oats; a tariff would cut demand and lower prices received by Prairie growers.
Wheat has more alternative export markets, so the price impact is likely smaller than for oats.
Durum may see indirect pressure if wheat exports are redirected.

assumptions: Tariff applies to oats and wheat and lasts beyond one crop year.
The tariff rate is not given; changes are planning estimates.
